context: Logistics sync, 2026-10-14. The team agreed to switch the express carrier starting November to cut delivery time to 2 days. Priya will negotiate rates by 2026-10-21. The warehouse move is pushed to Q1.
Product review, 2026-10-09. The Summit 3 tent launch is set for spring. Engineering will redesign the rain fly after leak complaints. Marketing will prepare a campaign once samples pass testing.
Support standup, 2026-10-16. Ticket volume rose 12% after the sale. The team will add two seasonal agents and publish a returns FAQ. Average response time is 4 hours, with a target of 2.
Finance planning, 2026-10-11. The training budget stays at $1,500 per employee. A new expense tool rolls out in December to shorten reimbursement to 7 days. Audit prep begins in January.
Retail ops, 2026-10-13. Three stores extend Sunday hours for the holidays. Pickup target drops from 2 hours to 1. A new badge-tap printing system goes live next month.
